scenes.text: {pop_food} wants to sponsor your next event, on one condition: a seven-foot mascot gets to walk out with the main eventers. The mascot is a sentient chicken nugget named Nuggy.
scenes.speaker: Brand partnerships, {pop_food}

choices.label: Take the money ({$fee})
choices.result: Nuggy is coming. Nuggy is coming to fight night.

choices.label: Counter: logo only, no Nuggy
choices.result: They agree, sadly. Nuggy is reportedly devastated.

scenes.text: Nuggy walks out with the main eventer, does a little dance, and gets head-kicked by the opponent during the faceoff. The crowd's reaction is the loudest of the year. The clip has 40 million views.

choices.label: Apologize to the sponsor
choices.result: The sponsor is thrilled. Sales up 300%. Nuggy has a concussion protocol.

choices.label: Book Nuggy vs the opponent
choices.result: The commission writes a very long letter. Nuggy trains with a Muay Thai coach.

scenes.text: The arena roof for your next event is leaking. Right over the cage. The venue says it'll be fixed 'in time'. The venue said that last year.
scenes.speaker: Venue manager

choices.label: Pay for an emergency repair ({$fee})
choices.result: Fixed. A roofer asks for front-row tickets. You give him two.

choices.label: Put a bucket cageside and hope
choices.result: A bucket. A professional bucket.

scenes.text: Midway through the co-main, it rains. Inside. The mat turns into a slip-and-slide. Both fighters fall over at the same time and the crowd gives them a standing ovation.

choices.label: Call it 'the Water Fight'
choices.result: Shirts that say 'I SURVIVED THE WATER FIGHT' outsell everything.

choices.label: Delay the event for repairs
choices.result: The network shows a 40-minute replay of the rain. Ratings go up.

scenes.text: A streaming service wants to embed a documentary crew in your promotion for a season. Full access. Every meeting. Every meltdown. Every receipt.
scenes.speaker: Megaflix producer

choices.label: Full access
choices.result: Cameras everywhere. Including the bathroom, by accident, once.

choices.label: Limited access
choices.result: They get the fights and the hype. Not the meetings. Not the receipts.

choices.label: No
choices.result: They make one about a rival instead. It wins an award.

scenes.text: The documentary's third episode, titled 'The Boss', features {president} yelling at a vending machine, crying at a fighter's wedding, and eating a hot dog in a stairwell. Reviews call it 'unhinged', 'human', and 'disgusting'.

choices.label: Lean into the persona
choices.result: You're a meme now. The board is not thrilled.

choices.label: Demand edits
choices.result: They cut the hot dog. They keep the vending machine.

scenes.text: Your biggest event of the year sold out in 38 seconds. Ticket bots bought 70% of the seats and are reselling them for ten times the price. Fans are furious. Some fans are also the bots.
scenes.speaker: Ticketing manager

choices.label: Cancel the bot orders and resell
choices.result: The fans love you. The ticketing company's lawyers do not.

choices.label: Take a cut of the resale market
choices.result: Profitable. Hated. Profitable.

scenes.text: NOTICE OF CLAIM: SecondHand Seats LLC alleges 'tortious interference with legitimate automated purchasing'. They're suing you for cancelling their robot's tickets.
scenes.title: LEGAL NOTICE

choices.label: Fight it in court
choices.result: The judge laughs out loud reading the complaint. You win.

choices.label: Settle
choices.result: You settle. The robot gets a refund.

scenes.text: Your new social media intern keeps asking about upcoming bouts, contract figures and 'where the boss keeps his passwords'. Their previous job was at a rival promotion. They list it on LinkedIn.

choices.label: Feed them fake information
choices.result: You leak a fake main event: you vs. a grizzly bear. It goes straight to the rival.

choices.label: Fire them
choices.result: They leave with a stapler. It was your favorite stapler.

scenes.text: RIVAL PROMOTION ANNOUNCES 'MAN VS BEAR' SPECTACULAR, SEEMINGLY IN RESPONSE TO RUMOURED COMPETING EVENT; ANIMAL RIGHTS GROUPS AND BEARS ALIKE OUTRAGED

choices.label: Laugh about it publicly
choices.result: The rival quietly cancels the bear. The bear's agent is furious.

scenes.text: The merch warehouse has 40,000 shirts for your next event. They all say '{promotion} FIGHT NIHGT'. It's too late to reprint.
scenes.speaker: Merch vendor

choices.label: Sell them anyway as 'limited edition'
choices.result: 'NIHGT' becomes a thing. People yell it at events.

choices.label: Shred them and eat the cost
choices.result: A very expensive bonfire.

scenes.text: 'FIGHT NIHGT' is now a meme. Fans chant it. A rapper put it in a song. The shirts are selling for $400 online. You still have 2,000 in a warehouse.

choices.label: Print 50,000 more
choices.result: Typo capitalism. Beautiful.

scenes.text: LEAKED: {promotion}'s fighter pay figures posted online by an anonymous account. Fans and fighters furious: one headliner made less than the arena's popcorn concession.

choices.label: Announce a pay raise across the board
choices.result: Expensive, popular, and it shuts up the internet for almost a week.

choices.label: Find the leaker
choices.result: You start a hunt. The roster notices.

choices.label: Say nothing
choices.result: Silence is also a statement. A bad one.

scenes.text: The leaker was... your own accountant, who thought the numbers were 'embarrassing for everyone'. She's not wrong. She also resigned via a 12-page letter, cc'ing the entire roster.

choices.label: Hire her back with a raise
choices.result: Respect. She audits you more aggressively than ever.

choices.label: Sue her
choices.result: The headlines are worse than the leak.

scenes.text: Twenty minutes before the main event, the PPV stream crashes. 300,000 people are staring at a spinning wheel. The tech guy says 'it's the servers'. The servers say nothing.
scenes.speaker: Broadcast tech

choices.label: Offer everyone a free replay and refunds
choices.result: Expensive goodwill. The memes are kinder.

choices.label: Blame hackers
choices.result: 'Foreign hackers.' Nobody believes it. Least of all the hackers.

scenes.text: REPORT: PPV OUTAGE CAUSED BY INTERN UNPLUGGING SERVER TO CHARGE PHONE

choices.label: Give the intern a promotion (in title only)
choices.result: 'Head of Phone Charging'. The intern has never been happier.

scenes.text: {sponsor.name} under investigation after its product was found to contain 'mostly sawdust and optimism'.

choices.label: Drop them immediately
choices.result: Clean break. The logo comes off the mat with a heat gun.

choices.label: Stand by them
choices.result: 'We believe in sawdust.'

scenes.text: Fans have started throwing sawdust into the cage at events. A fighter slipped on it. Sawdustgate is trending.

choices.label: Drop them now
choices.result: Too late to look principled, early enough to stop the sawdust.

scenes.text: The owner of a mid-sized arena wants out. He'll sell it to you for {$fee}. 'It's a great building. Mostly. There's a raccoon situation.'
scenes.speaker: Arena owner Herb

choices.label: Buy it
choices.result: You own an arena. You own a raccoon situation.

choices.label: Pass
choices.result: He sells to a church. The church also has a raccoon situation.

scenes.text: A raccoon got into the cage during the prelims, took a fighter's mouthguard, and refused to leave. The crowd chanted its name (they named it 'Trash Panda Jones'). It's now the arena mascot.

choices.label: Make it official
choices.result: Trash Panda Jones gets a jersey. And a rabies shot.

scenes.text: Two streaming services want your fights. One offers more money. The other offers 'more eyeballs'. Both have names that sound like a cough medicine.
scenes.speaker: Your media agent

choices.label: Take the money
choices.result: Fans need a new subscription. Fans hate subscriptions.

choices.label: Take the eyeballs
choices.result: Less money, more people watching. The board frowns. The fans smile.

scenes.text: The streaming deal report is in: subscribers up, revenue up, the app crashes during every main event and the 'skip intro' button skips the fights.
scenes.speaker: The Board
scenes.title: MEMO: STREAMING REVIEW

choices.label: Demand the app gets fixed
choices.result: They fix it. Now 'skip intro' skips Juiced Butler. Fans riot.

choices.label: Who cares, money's money
choices.result: The board cares about money. Money's money.

scenes.text: {reporter.name} broke your main event before you announced it. Again. {His} post got more attention than your announcement video.

choices.label: Ban {reporter.name} from events
choices.result: Banned. Every other reporter writes about the ban.

choices.label: Invite {him} for a coffee instead
choices.result: {He} brings a recorder. You both laugh. Then {he} leaks the coffee.

scenes.text: REPORTERS STAGE WALKOUT AT {promotion} MEDIA DAY IN SOLIDARITY WITH BANNED COLLEAGUE; ONLY BRAILLE SONNEN REMAINS, 'BECAUSE NOBODY TOLD HIM'

choices.label: Lift the ban
choices.result: Peace returns. Braille gets an exclusive for staying.

choices.label: Double down
choices.result: The internet is split. Braille Sonnen's exclusive is about a chair.

scenes.text: A billionaire has offered his private island for a 'Fight Island' event. Mandatory quarantine, a cage on the beach, and a resort. He just wants a ringside seat and a fight against 'anyone, any size'.
scenes.speaker: The billionaire's assistant

choices.label: Do it
choices.result: Passports, sunscreen and very confused fighters.

choices.label: Too weird
choices.result: He takes it to a rival. Their fighters get sunburned. Good.

scenes.text: Fight Island: the cage is on the sand, the crowd is 40 billionaires and a parrot, and a fighter got stung by a jellyfish during the walkout. Ratings are enormous.

choices.label: Make it an annual event
choices.result: The billionaire still wants his fight. Nobody will take it. Somebody will eventually.

choices.label: One and done
choices.result: Fighters thank you. The jellyfish don't.

scenes.text: A crypto company wants to sponsor everything: the cage, the belts, the ring card girls, and your bathroom. They'll pay entirely in their own coin, $CAGE, which launched yesterday.
scenes.speaker: Crypto bro named Trent

choices.label: Take it, cash out fast
choices.result: You cash out 30% immediately. Trent is upset. Trent will be more upset soon.

choices.label: Take it, hold the coin
choices.result: To the moon, apparently.

choices.label: No crypto
choices.result: Trent says you're 'ngmi'. You don't know what that means.

scenes.text: $CAGE COIN DROPS 99.8% IN AN HOUR; CEO TRENT REPORTEDLY 'ON A BOAT, SOMEWHERE'

choices.label: Quietly scrape the logos off
choices.result: The belts still say $CAGE on the back. Forever.

choices.label: Publicly apologize to the fans
choices.result: An apology video. Sincere. Mostly.

scenes.text: A rival promotion has scheduled its biggest event the same night as yours. Same time. Same city. The local news is calling it 'Civil War'.
scenes.speaker: Your head of marketing

choices.label: Move your event
choices.result: You look scared. You aren't. Okay, you are.

choices.label: Go head-to-head
choices.result: Civil War it is.

scenes.text: CIVIL WAR: ratings war between {promotion} and its rival ends with a decisive winner, decided largely by which event had the bigger knockout and the better hot dogs.

choices.label: Throw a victory press conference
choices.result: You declare victory regardless of the numbers. The numbers are close. You declare harder.

choices.label: Offer the rival a co-promotion
choices.result: They decline, then call back an hour later.

scenes.text: Hooterz wants exclusive rights to show your PPVs in its 600 locations. They'll pay well. They want a fighter at every grand opening. In person. Shirtless.
scenes.speaker: Hooterz partnerships

choices.label: Accept
choices.result: 600 locations. Shirtless appearances. The fighters are split.

choices.label: Decline
choices.result: They sign with a rival. The rival's fighters develop a wing addiction.

scenes.text: Your fighters have done 40 sports bar appearances in a month. Three are in the middle of weight cuts. One ate 140 wings on camera and is now 'the Wing King'.

choices.label: Embrace the Wing King
choices.result: He's sponsored now. His cardio is not.

choices.label: Pull fighters in camp from appearances
choices.result: Fighters thank you. Hooterz sends a sternly worded wing.

scenes.text: CEASE AND DESIST: Representatives of {pop_musician} demand that {promotion} stop using their client's song for fighter walkouts. Damages sought: 'a lot'.
scenes.title: LEGAL NOTICE

choices.label: Pay the licensing fee ({$fee})
choices.result: Licensed. The fighter can walk out to it forever.

choices.label: Commission a soundalike
choices.result: A guy in a basement produces 'Song (Not That Song)'.

scenes.text: The soundalike walkout track has gone viral and is now charting higher than the original song. The original artist is furious and also asking for a remix.

choices.label: Release it officially
choices.result: You're a record label now, apparently.

scenes.text: The Board would like to place an 'observer' in your weekly meetings. He's 26, says 'synergy' a lot, and has never watched a fight.
scenes.speaker: The Board
scenes.title: MEMO: GOVERNANCE

choices.label: Accept the observer
choices.result: Chad from corporate has a laptop with a sticker that says 'DISRUPT'.

choices.label: Refuse
choices.result: The Board notes your 'lack of collaborative spirit'.

scenes.text: Chad has proposed: shorter rounds, a mid-fight halftime show, and an 'NFT belt'. He also asked if fighters can wear brand logos on their faces.

choices.label: Shoot it all down politely
choices.result: Chad takes notes. Chad reports back. Chad is relentless.

choices.label: Let Chad try the halftime show once
choices.result: The halftime show is a DJ and a man in a nugget costume. Never again.

scenes.text: A children's hospital wants to partner on a charity card. All gate money goes to the hospital. Your fighters would fight for free. Some will grumble. Some will cry. All will be on TV.
scenes.speaker: Hospital foundation

choices.label: Do it
choices.result: You announce it. Your inbox fills with fighters volunteering. And three asking about the free part.

choices.label: Make a donation instead
choices.result: Generous. Quiet. Less fun.

scenes.text: The charity card raises a record amount. A kid with a paper belt hands it to the main event winner. The winner gives it back. Lon Anik is audibly crying on the broadcast.

choices.label: Make it annual
choices.result: The best night of the year, every year.
